RunnerCapacity.definition: Number of bags a runner can carry each trip

RunnerTime.definition: Time a runner takes per trip (in hours)

CanoeCapacity.definition: Number of bags a canoeer can carry each trip

CanoeTime.definition: Time a canoeer takes per trip (in hours)

MaxCanoePercentage.definition: Maximum fraction of total deliveries that can be made by canoe

MaxTotalHours.definition: Maximum total hours the village can spare for deliveries

MinRunners.definition: Minimum number of runners that must be used
